title: GitHub Profile Card & Jet Heatmap Configuration
description: Single configuration file to customize all details of your GitHub profile README cards and animated jet heatmap.

username.description: Your GitHub username (used to fetch live contributions and profile picture).

name.description: Your display name / subject name shown on the terminal card.

commandTitle.description: Shell prompt command shown in the terminal title bar (e.g. somya@codes ~ % ./profile.sh --live).

role.description: Your primary title or role (e.g. AI/ML Engineer · Full Stack).

status.description: Your current status or focus (e.g. Building · Learning · Shipping).

auto.description: Automatically fetch your GitHub profile picture.

url.description: Custom avatar image URL (optional, overrides auto fetch if provided).

borderGlow.description: Hex color for the avatar HUD glowing border (e.g. #22C55E).

badgeText.description: Status badge label under avatar (e.g. PILOT // ONLINE).

skills.description: Key-value map of your skills, tech stack, and toolchains.

contacts.description: Key-value map of your contact info, social handles, or portfolio links.

title.description: Footer label for the jet heatmap defense grid.
